acceptance_and_cleanup.cooperative_scan_metric_gate: Each node must report gallery mode, three configured workers, positive completed-task deltas from each of veortex-scan-0/1/2, zero failed tasks, balanced global/per-worker completion counters, zero active tasks at row boundaries, and max_active_tasks at most three.

comparison.kind: historical matched category / B1 / concurrency comparison; not a same-ELF A/B

conclusion: All eight production-path candidate cells passed the recorded routing, scan-worker, cleanup, and per-cell F32 oracle gates. Each candidate cell was slower than its historical three-worker query-split comparator. The comparison is across different source commits and ELFs, so it is not a same-binary A/B or causal attribution.

diagnostics_interpretation.cache: A fresh campaign COW set was reused across cells; host page cache was not reset.
diagnostics_interpretation.cpu: Candidate per-node whole-process CPU equivalents use process tick deltas over the observer window (which includes warmup, dispatch, and drain); named scan-worker tick equivalents are provided as a separate diagnostic attribution. These values are not just the 30-second dispatch window.
diagnostics_interpretation.logical_nq: query_vector_dots / gallery_vectors_read is the receipt-defined work-weighted logical reuse ratio. It is not physical DRAM traffic or a bandwidth measurement.
diagnostics_interpretation.not_promoted: The measured gallery adapter was not promoted. A later source edit a492425e6 has not been built or measured and is not part of these results.
diagnostics_interpretation.scan_tasks: Cooperative scan task counters are scheduler task units, not query counts; exact per-node and per-worker deltas are included in each row.
diagnostics_interpretation.scope: This is a 3M-point cluster HTTP diagnostic. The prior 4,334 scan-query/s result was a separate 1M-point scorer-only component and is not a directly comparable HTTP-RPS target.
diagnostics_interpretation.source_derived_scratch: Candidate source estimates 393,276 bytes of bounded scratch per scoring job. This is a source-derived allocation figure, not measured physical memory traffic, DRAM bandwidth, or a causal explanation of throughput.
diagnostics_interpretation.stage_timers: Cumulative per-thread stage timers can overlap and are not additive end-to-end latency.

first_attempt.adjudication: The attempt remains rejected: its gallery-scan CPU proof gate did not pass. The accepted follow-up is reported separately; the earlier row was not rewritten or reclassified.
